description: NaInH₆(SeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.44 Å. There are two inequivalent In sites. In the first In site, In is bonded to four H and two equivalent O atoms to form InH₄O₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.70 Å) and two longer (1.71 Å) In-H bond lengths. Both In-O bond lengths are 2.39 Å. In the second In site, In is bonded to four H and two equivalent O atoms to form InH₄O₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra. All In-H bond lengths are 1.71 Å. Both In-O bond lengths are 2.37 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one In atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one In atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.02 Å) and one longer (1.63 Å) H-O bond length. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one In atom. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one In atom. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one InH₄O₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 55°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.78 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one InH₄O₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.77 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one In, one H, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one In, one H, and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one H and one Se atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one H and one Se atom.
